items.question: Where were you living when Jo Stafford's "You Belong to Me" was number one, and who in your house liked it?

items.text: Postage for a domestic letter was 3 cents an ounce.
items.question: Where were you living when a stamp for a letter cost three cents, and who did you write to?

items.text: The Today Show premiered on NBC on January 14, 1952.
items.question: Do you remember the first time you saw the Today Show, and whose television it was on?
items.source_quote: January 14 – The Today Show premieres on NBC, becoming one of the longest-running television series in America.

items.text: The New York Yankees beat the Brooklyn Dodgers, 4 games to 3, to win the World Series on October 7, 1952.
items.question: Who in your family rooted for the Yankees or the Dodgers in the 1952 World Series, and how did you follow the games?
items.source_quote: October 7 – The New York Yankees defeat the Brooklyn Dodgers, 4 games to 3, to win their 15th World Series Title.

items.text: The ocean liner SS United States made her maiden crossing of the Atlantic on July 3, 1952.
items.question: Do you remember hearing about the ocean liner SS United States, and did anyone you knew ever cross the Atlantic by ship?
items.source_quote: July 3 – The ocean liner SS United States makes her maiden crossing of the Atlantic.
